cd m

stdout '^--- PASS: TestLocalOptions '
stdout '^--- PASS: TestForeignOptions '

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/optionfields

go 1.27

-- m/fields.lgo --
package fields

import (
	"comptime"

	"example.com/optionfields/label"
)

type ForeignRow struct {
	Label label.Text?
}

func CopyFields[T any](row, out T) T {
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out.[f] = ReadField[f.Type](&row.[f])
	}
	return out
}

func CopyThroughProjection[T any](row, out T) T {
	const if !comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		comptime.Error("expected a struct")
	}
	return CopyProjected[T](row, out)
}

func CopyProjected[T any](row, out T) T {
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out.[f] = ReadProjection[T, f.Type](&row, func(e *T) *f.Type { return &e.[f] })
	}
	return out
}

func ReadField[F any](field *F) F {
	return *field
}

func ReadProjection[T, F any](row *T, project func(*T) *F) F {
	return *project(row)
}

-- m/label/label.lgo --
package label

type Text string

-- m/fields_test.lgo --
package fields_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/optionfields"
)

type localRow struct {
	Note  string?
	Cell  *(string?)
	Link  *int?
	Array [1](string?)
}

func TestLocalOptions(t *testing.T) {
	var cell string? = "cell"
	link := 37
	row := localRow{Note: "note", Cell: &cell, Link: &link, Array: [1](string?){"array"}}
	var otherCell string? = "other cell"
	otherLink := 73
	dst := localRow{
		Note:  "other note",
		Cell:  &otherCell,
		Link:  &otherLink,
		Array: [1](string?){"other array"},
	}
	checkLocal(t, fields.CopyFields[localRow](row, dst), &cell, &link)
	checkLocal(t, fields.CopyThroughProjection[localRow](row, dst), &cell, &link)
}

func checkLocal(t *testing.T, got localRow, cell *(string?), link *int) {
	t.Helper()
	if (got.Note ?? "") != "note" || (got.Array[0] ?? "") != "array" {
		t.Errorf("lost option payload: %+v", got)
	}
	if got.Cell != cell {
		t.Error("pointer to option no longer refers to the caller's field")
	}
	fallback := 0
	if (got.Link ?? &fallback) != link {
		t.Error("option of pointer no longer contains the caller's pointer")
	}
}

func TestForeignOptions(t *testing.T) {
	row := fields.ForeignRow{Label: "foreign"}
	got := fields.CopyThroughProjection[fields.ForeignRow](row, fields.ForeignRow{Label: "other"})
	if (got.Label ?? "") != "foreign" {
		t.Errorf("lost named option payload: %+v", got)
	}
	got = fields.CopyFields[fields.ForeignRow](fields.ForeignRow{}, fields.ForeignRow{Label: "other"})
	if got.Label != nil {
		t.Errorf("missing option became present: %+v", got)
	}
}
